title: AiRunCreateResult
description: ai.run-create-result@1: answers of ai.run.create on OpenVibe.AI. POST /api/v1/runs and the direct operations → { run, replayed? } (201 when it finished or was served from cache within the wait, 202 with Location while queued or running, 200 with replayed true for an idempotent repeat); POST …/cancel → { run }; POST …/retry → { run } (a new run with retry_of); POST …/citations → 201 { citations }. A quota refusal or a full queue is 429 with Retry-After.
